stem: Each month a company sells $X$ kg of brown sugar and $Y$ kg of white sugar, where $X$ and $Y$ have the independent distributions $\text{N}(2500, 120^2)$ and $\text{N}(3700, 130^2)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the mean and standard deviation of the total amount of sugar that the company sells in 3 randomly chosen months.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The company makes a profit of \$1.50 per kilogram of brown sugar sold and makes a loss of \$0.20 per kilogram of white sugar sold.
parts.text: Find the probability that, in a randomly chosen month, the total profit is less than \$3000.
